meta.name: folklore-variant-evidence
meta.description: Retrieve ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and review source-linked public evidence and literature for one supported GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel through Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP. Use when a scientific agent must branch deterministically on resolved, ambiguous, not-found, invalid, unsupported, or unavailable variant outcomes; chain a resolved public variant into related literature or publication details; or preserve evidence provenance without accepting patient, phenotype, family, segregation, or private case data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询基因与疾病的 ClinGen 证据,核对变异相关文献出处
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在遗传变异解读中需要核对公开证据与文献来源。
copy.tagline_en: Look up ClinGen gene-disease assertions and trace the literature behind a variant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify public evidence and sources while interpreting genetic variants.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可通过 Folklore MCP 按状态分支查询公共变异的公共证据与来源文献,并获取 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言。
howto.when: 当你要查某个公共基因或疾病与变异的证据、把已解析的变异链条到文献,或需按 resolved、ambiguous 等状态分支处理时触发。

say.text: 用 GRCh38 查询 rs80357914 的公共变异证据
say.note: 若返回 ambiguous,需你明确选择候选

say.text: 查一下 BRCA1 的 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言
say.note: 返回疾病、遗传方式、来源与日期

say.text: 把已解析变异的 canonical_key 链条到相关文献
say.note: 只有 resolved 结果会自动进入文献流程

howto.what_en: After install, Claude queries public variant evidence, linked literature, and ClinGen gene-disease assertions via the Folklore MCP, branching on resolved, ambiguous, and other statuses while keeping source links.
howto.when_en: Use when you need public evidence for one gene, disease, or variant, chain a resolved variant into literature, or branch deterministically on resolved, ambiguous, and other returned statuses.

say_en.text: Look up public variant evidence for rs80357914 in GRCh38
say_en.note: Ambiguous results stop for your explicit candidate choice

say_en.text: Get ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for BRCA1
say_en.note: Returns disease, inheritance, source, and date

say_en.text: Chain the resolved variant's canonical_key into related literature
say_en.note: Only a resolved result proceeds automatically
